the question of which factors influence the success of ERP systems in SMEs and which factors are more important than others.
the identification of critical success factors for ERP systems in SMEs and their comparison to those CSFs that are relevant in large-scale projects.

the CSFs of ERP projects in large companies do not differ from those in SMEs, but their importance varies.
the CSFs for ERP projects are similar for SMEs and large-scale enterprises, but the importance of the factors differs.
the CSFs of ERP projects are not only dependent on company size but also on the specific characteristics of the project.
